arguments.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', t.date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS transactions FROM transactions t WHERE t.date >= '2019-01-01' AND t.date < '2020-01-01' AND t.transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', t.date) ORDER BY month
arguments.explanation: Counts online transactions in each month of 2019, in month order, using the same monthly grouping as before.
assumptions: The data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, so months November and December will not appear.
